description: This file implements functions for escaping JSON strings, including handling Unicode characters, ASCII characters, and special characters, as part of the base JSON utilities in Chromium.

methods.name: EscapeJSONString
methods.description: Escapes a string for JSON encoding, handling ASCII, Unicode, and special characters, with optional quotes.

methods.name: EscapeBytesAsInvalidJSONString
methods.description: Escapes a byte string as an invalid JSON string, handling non-printable characters.
